title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
description: Music creation is inherently iterative, yet many symbolic generation systems still center on producing or regenerating isolated outputs. We present IteraSong, an interactive web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) for LLM-guided iterative symbolic music creation. Unlike one-shot generation systems, IteraSong supports a generate-audition-edit-refine loop over a persistent multi-track project. Use
authors: Di Lu, Xinran Zhang, Yan Gao
